title: Derived evaluation detects equality between single towers
statement: Let A be an abelian category with chosen derived localizations of A and of strict inverse systems in A in a common universe. For strict towers M,N and two derived arrows M[0]→N[0], if exact derived evaluation at every natural-number level sends them to equal maps, then the arrows are equal. No faithfulness of evaluation for arbitrary derived objects is asserted.

proof.text: Fullness of the single functor writes each arrow as the single image of a tower morphism. Naturality of the single/evaluation comparison and faithfulness of the single embedding in A identify every component. Natural-transformation extensionality gives equality of the tower morphisms and hence of their single images.

    (A : Type u) [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A)]
